TEST streaming failover (anthropic.test.js), fake SDK via Module._load re-exporting the real error classes; fake stream = scripted events, honours signal, ends quietly on abort like the real SDK. Cases: single model ok → text deltas, _final_model, [DONE], connection aborted at message_stop (E27); 529 before stream on 1 of 2 → maxRetries 1 then 2 recorded, one _reset{next_model, reason:"transient"}, second answers (SC-003, E14, E15); stream error event after text → _reset, second answers (E17); 404 → reason "unavailable", 5 min cooldown (E18), only model → unavailable userMessage (E19); 400/401 → no second call, userMessage "<model> — <reason>" (E20, E21); first-text timeout → reason "timeout", 10 s cooldown, deadline cuts the next attempt (E22, E23); deadline with models left → "No answer within" (E24); answer streaming past the deadline not cut (E25); idle timeout after text (E26) but not before first text; refusal with partial → _reset reason "refusal", no cooldown (E28), last model → declined message (E29); max_tokens no text → failover (E30), with text → success (E31); fallback block mid-stream → no _reset, _final_model = to.model (E32); beta rejected 400 → resend once without, never again (E41); cancel during attempt and after text → signal aborted, no error, request log cancelled (SC-004, E33, E34); enqueue after cancel does not throw (E35); all fail → "All Claude models failed (n attempts). Last: …"; attempt log fields present and no log line contains the scripted answer text (C3); temperature passed by the caller absent from params (SC-005).

Implement createStreamingLLM: attempt loop over parseModelList(model) with modelHealth, per-attempt SDK options { signal, maxRetries: remaining>1 ? 1 : 2, timeout: 15000 }, event handling (message_start model/usage, content_block_start fallback, text_delta, message_delta stop_reason/usage, message_stop → abort and finish), timers (first text, idle after first text, deadline), flags checked after the quiet SDK end, classification + cooldowns + _reset, cancel()/track()/safeEnqueue, logAttempt/logRequest without text, userMessage per FR-019, one-time beta disable per FR-009.
